description: Figure 4 is a line plot titled "Hidden State Mean" that compares the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers of a model, both before and after a gating mechanism is applied. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 25 in increments of 5, representing the layer number in the model. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4, representing the mean absolute value of the hidden states. The plot displays three distinct lines: a dashed blue line representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts at an average value of 0.71 and shows a general upward trend, increasing from approximately 0.5 at layer 0 to over 4.0 at layer 25. A dotted orange line, representing the "hidden state mean after gate," starts at an average value of 0.05 and remains relatively flat, staying close to 0.05 across all layers. A solid green line, representing the "hidden state mean of baseline," starts at an average value of 0.04 and also remains nearly flat, staying close to 0.04 across all layers. The caption indicates that the baseline and post-gating values are similar, which is visually supported by the close proximity of the dotted orange and solid green lines.
